mapper.select: select inq_no ,inq_title ,inq_content ,inq_name ,answerYn ,inq_regdate from tbl_inquiry order by inq_no desc

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN inq_regdate >= CURDATE() AND inq_regdate < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN inq_no END) AS dayCnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN inq_regdate >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND inq_regdate < CURDATE() THEN inq_no END) AS weekCnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN inq_regdate >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND inq_regdate < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01') THEN inq_no END) AS monthCnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN YEAR(inq_regdate) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND inq_regdate >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-01-01') AND inq_regdate < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 YEAR, '%Y-01-01') THEN inq_no END) AS yearCnt FROM tbl_inquiry
